tutorial.say: This clue (a broken heart) counts only the ISOLATED bombs in its 3x3 block. A bomb is isolated when none of the four cells next to it (up, down, left, right) is a bomb.
Look at the bombs in this block. These two touch each other, so neither is isolated: they do not count.
This one has no bomb beside it, so it is isolated and counts. That is why the clue says 1.
Remember: bombs in a pair or a group do not count - only the lonely ones. A 0 does not mean the block is empty, it can hide bombs that touch each other.

tutorial.play: Your turn! The board is cleared again. Find all the bombs.
